name: Sample Candidate
headline: Operations Support
Stock Records
Order Coordination
summary: Operations assistant with experience maintaining stock and order records for a retail fulfilment team. Uses Excel to reconcile records, track discrepancies and prepare updates for warehouse and customer-service colleagues.

experience.title: Operations Assistant
bullets: Reconciled Excel stock records against physical counts and flagged discrepancies for follow-up.
Checked order details and coordinated record updates with warehouse and customer-service colleagues.
Organised campaign order records and prepared daily status updates for the operations supervisor.

experience.title: Retail Assistant
bullets: Recorded incoming deliveries, checked item quantities and updated stock sheets.
Prepared replenishment lists and referred stock discrepancies to the store supervisor.

achievements: Recognised internally for maintaining clear campaign order records.
